== Summary ==
Before/after image for [[Yoda's Hope (V)#Source formats|Yoda's Hope (V) (Errata)]]: the PC card image of [[Yoda's Hope (V)]] (7 August 2025, [[:File:V25-L-yodashope.gif|V25-L-yodashope.gif]], scaled to the slip height) beside the slip of the [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (page 8). Made from the two published images (Bill, 12 November 2026).
